name: pey.storage
description: Generic storage service backed by a swappable adapter (currently IndexedDB)

provides.name: pey.storage.service
provides.description: Generic key-value and record storage with CRUD, query, bulk, transaction, and import/export capabilities

methods.name: read
methods.description: Read a single record by key from a collection

methods.name: write
methods.description: Write (insert or update) a single record

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Delete a single record by key

methods.name: query
methods.description: Query records with a raw index/range criteria. Supports exact match { field: value } and range { field: { gte, lte, gt, lt } } where each key is optional and any combination is valid. A criteria key that is not a live database index is served by a full-store scan filtered on that record field (results identical to the in-memory adapter; slow on very large stores).

methods.name: count
methods.description: Count records, optionally filtered by a raw range query criteria. Supports exact match { field: value } and range { field: { gte, lte, gt, lt } }. A criteria key that is not a live database index is served by a full-store scan filtered on that record field (slow on very large stores).

methods.name: bulkWrite
methods.description: Bulk insert or update multiple records atomically

params.name: operations
params.type: Array<{ collection: string, method: string, args: Array }>

methods.name: exportData
methods.description: Export records as a JSON-compatible payload with metadata

methods.name: importData
methods.description: Import a previously exported payload with replace, merge, or restore mode. Restore mode atomically replaces all target collections via a single adapter.transaction() call.
methods.returns: Promise<{ imported: number, skipped: object[], deleted: number, errors: object[] }>

events.name: storage:ready
events.description: Published after all configured stores have been created or migrated and the database is fully operational
